pricing.label: Small home

All clips, timers and extension runs supplied
Takedown in January and storage until next year

pricing.label: Large home
pricing.note: Two storeys, several roof planes, or a yard tree wrapped as well
features: Upper rooflines, peaks, dormers and gable runs
One tree or entry feature wrapped to about 12 feet
Photocell timer set to your porch light

pricing.label: Commercial
pricing.note: Storefronts, HOA entries and downtown blocks — the figure is in writing before anything is ordered
features: Walked and measured with you before a quote is written
A current certificate of insurance — ask us, and every other bidder, for one
Multi-year pricing held when the same design comes back

included: Design walk, roofline measurement and a written figure before anything is ordered
Commercial-grade C9 bulbs, clips, timers and extension runs — all supplied by us
Installation on rooflines, peaks, dormers, porches and entry columns
Every service call between install and takedown: outages, wind damage, timer drift
Off-season storage, coiled and labelled by roofline
notIncluded: Interior decorating, trees indoors, or anything past the front door

hero.kicker: Seasonal roofline & tree lighting · Sandpoint, Idaho
hero.title: Nobody should spend December on a frozen ladder.
hero.subtitle: Cedar & Filament designs, hangs, services and removes holiday lighting across Sandpoint and Bonner County. One price covers the whole season — the install in November, every service call in December, and the takedown in January.

about.heading: A season, not an afternoon
about.body: Most people who hang their own lights do it once, in the cold, and then live with whatever went up. We measure the rooflines in the fall, cut the runs to fit your house, and store them labelled so the second year goes up in a morning. When a run goes dark in the middle of December, that is ours to come out and fix, not yours.

howItWorks.title: Book in the fall
howItWorks.desc: We walk the house, measure the rooflines and put the design and the figure in writing. Nothing is ordered until you say yes.

howItWorks.title: Install in November
howItWorks.desc: Runs are cut to your measurements, clipped to the shingle line or gutter edge, and set on a timer before we leave.

howItWorks.title: Serviced through December
howItWorks.desc: A bulb out, a run down after a windstorm, a timer drifting — call and we come out. It is already in the price.

howItWorks.title: Down in January
howItWorks.desc: We pull everything by mid-January, coil it labelled by roofline, and store it until next season.

included.title: Commercial-grade bulbs
included.desc: C9 and C7 lamps on heavy lead wire — the same stock that goes up downtown, not the strands that turn brittle at ten below.

included.title: Cut to your house
included.desc: Every run is measured and cut for one roofline, so there is no slack looped over the gutter and no dark gap at the peak.

included.title: Clips, never staples
included.desc: Shingle and gutter clips carry the wire. Nothing is stapled, nailed or screwed into your roof.

included.title: Timers set on site
included.desc: A photocell or programmed timer goes in at install, so the display comes on at dusk without anyone touching a switch.

included.title: Service calls included
included.desc: Outages, wind damage and timer drift are covered from install through takedown. No trip charge in season.

included.title: Takedown and storage
included.desc: Removed by mid-January and stored labelled by roofline, so a second season is an install and not a redesign.

niche.pricingNote: Every figure above covers the whole season — design, install, all in-season service calls, takedown and storage. Roof pitch, height above two storeys and any custom colour run are quoted separately, and always in writing before anything is ordered.

faq.a: Installs run from the first week of November until the week before Christmas. Booking in September or October gets you a date you actually want.

Ours. The price is a seasonal package rather than a purchase — we supply, install, maintain, remove and store the material. If you would rather own the lights outright, ask and we will quote that separately.

faq.q: What happens if a section goes dark?
faq.a: Call us and we come out. In-season service is part of the package, so there is no trip charge between install and takedown.

faq.q: Do you put holes in the roof?
faq.a: No. Everything hangs on shingle tabs and gutter clips. Nothing is stapled, nailed or screwed into the roof or the fascia.

faq.q: What if it snows on install day?
faq.a: We work through normal winter weather but not on iced roofs or in high wind — that is a safety call, not a preference. If we push a date we tell you the same day and rebook you at the front of the line.
